data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

words.word: Biodiversity is essential for healthy ecosystems.
Biodiversity means different cultures.
Biodiversity is changing climate.
Many animals are losing their natural habitat.
Habitat is a type of weather.
Animals habitat in cities.
Wind is a renewable energy source.
Wind is renewable resource energy.
Renewable means very expensive.
Her aspiration is to study abroad.
Her aspiration is studying abroad to.
Aspiration is breathing in food.
She showed great enthusiasm for the project.
She showed enthusiastic for the project.
Enthusiasm is sadness.
He is known for his wisdom and experience.
He is wisdom person.
Wisdom is a skill you buy.
She felt jealous of her friend’s success.
She felt jealous to her friend.
Jealous means happy.
He felt relaxed after the holiday.
He felt relaxing after the holiday.
Relaxed is when you are nervous.
A tolerant society respects differences.
A tolerant society tolerate differences.
Tolerant means angry.
She felt worried about the exam.
She felt worried of the exam.
Worried means confident.
